scripts.dev: node scripts/assets/prepare-history.mjs && node scripts/assets/prepare-ocr.mjs && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.dev:web: node scripts/assets/prepare-history.mjs && node scripts/assets/prepare-ocr.mjs && pnpm --filter @arogya/web dev
scripts.setup:ai: uv sync --project services/api --extra classifier && uv run --project services/api --extra classifier python -m arogya_api.cli.setup_ai
scripts.setup: pnpm install && uv sync --project services/api && pnpm setup:ocr
scripts.build: node scripts/assets/prepare-history.mjs && node scripts/assets/prepare-ocr.mjs && pnpm --filter @arogya/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @arogya/web exec next typegen && pnpm --filter @arogya/web typecheck
scripts.lint: biome check . && uv run --project services/api ruff check services/api scripts
scripts.format: biome check --write . && uv run --project services/api ruff format services/api scripts
scripts.test: uv run --project services/api python -m pytest services/api/tests
scripts.eval:ai: uv run --project services/api python -m arogya_api.cli.evaluate --mode live
scripts.eval:gateway: uv run --project services/api python -m arogya_api.cli.evaluate --mode deterministic
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --project services/api python scripts/contracts/export.py && node scripts/contracts/generate-types.mjs
scripts.contracts:check: uv run --project services/api python scripts/contracts/export.py --check && node scripts/contracts/generate-types.mjs --check
scripts.setup:language: uv sync --project services/api --extra classifier --extra language && uv run --project services/api --extra language python -m arogya_api.cli.setup_speech
scripts.test:language: uv run --project services/api --extra language python scripts/verify/language.py
scripts.setup:server-ocr: pnpm setup:ocr && uv sync --project services/api --extra classifier --extra language --extra ocr && uv run --project services/api --extra ocr python -m arogya_api.cli.setup_ocr
scripts.start:local: uv run --project services/api --extra classifier --extra language --extra ocr python -m arogya_api.cli.serve
scripts.test:images: uv run --project services/api --extra ocr python scripts/verify/images.py
scripts.test:documents: uv run --project services/api --extra language python scripts/verify/documents.py
scripts.test:prescriptions: uv run --project services/api --extra ocr python scripts/verify/prescription.py
scripts.eval:recognition: uv run --project services/api --extra ocr python scripts/evaluate/recognition.py
scripts.test:conversations: uv run --project services/api --extra language python scripts/verify/conversations.py
